prediction_or_prohibition: ICP must add a prediction, compression, invariant, or prohibition beyond a fully specified standard dynamical model.
failure_threshold: No measurable or formal gain under fair comparison.
outcome_if_failed: Treat ICP as a redescription or heuristic rather than a new principle.

prediction_or_prohibition: Manipulating the proposed physical carrier should alter the future set or distribution in the specified way.
required_controls: Material, energetic, geometric, boundary, and intervention confounds.
failure_threshold: Carrier manipulation has no predicted effect across adequately powered tests.
outcome_if_failed: Reject or narrow the claimed causal role.

prediction_or_prohibition: The proposed ICP measure should be stable under equivalent descriptions and justified coarse-grainings.
failure_threshold: Measure changes arbitrarily while physical predictions remain equivalent.
outcome_if_failed: Revise the measure or restrict it to a declared observer/task level.

prediction_or_prohibition: Systems assigned the same constraint state should have the same specified future distribution absent an identified missing variable.
failure_threshold: Systematic predictive inequivalence under the declared state representation.
outcome_if_failed: The constraint state is insufficient; add variables or abandon the equivalence class.

prediction_or_prohibition: A transformation prohibited by a formal ICP version should not occur under the stated conditions.
required_controls: Predeclared conditions, error model, and replication.
failure_threshold: The prohibited transition occurs reproducibly beyond the declared tolerance.
outcome_if_failed: Falsify that formal version or its stated scope.

prediction_or_prohibition: A claimed irreducible history effect should survive adequate enlargement of the state or be explicitly restricted to reduced descriptions.
failure_threshold: History effect disappears under an empirically sufficient enlarged state.
outcome_if_failed: Narrow the claim to representation-dependent memory; do not infer fundamental inheritance.
